notes.title: Games in a game
notes.content:
Hi everyone. 

We hope you’re having a great 2023 so far!

We’re currently working on a Demo version of RollerCoaster Mechanic for you to enjoy.

In the meantime we wanted to show you a few minigame sneak peaks.

Firstly, a matching minigame.
Some repairs will be just a few clicks away, like the fuse matching minigame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/b216816a3e63f48eac6a3d7d41d588035874b94e.jpg[/img]

Just click on the appropriate fuse holders and match them to their respective locations, and boom! (Meaning “done” not like an explosion, though that might happen from time to time).

Of course, that is the most simple, early game example of the matching minigame.

The next one you might recognize if you have been paying close attention to our devlogs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/6ee14ef3342b3f1ba540d335717604daff2d7a8a.jpg[/img]

This is a memory minigame, in which you will have to memorize a combination in which the “fuse reset” buttons light up, and then repeat it to reactivate the electrical current.

We have more in store for you, but will not spoil it just yet.

As always…

Stay healthy, stay safe, and stay tuned for more Rollercoaster Mechanic info.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280660/Rollercoaster_Mechanic/

notes.title: The Chosen
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone[/b], hope you’re sitting comfortably. Today I will tell you a story.

There was an urn, to which all the votes were cast - opinions that would shape the future. 
But when all seemed well and properly organised, there suddenly was a tie! 
One final vote would decide, what the whole team could not. 

“[i]Take our vote[/i]” - said the designers, waving a lengthy documentation. 
“[i]This document contains all the arguments for our vote, why, how and when it should be chosen[/i].”

“[i]We have decided[/i]” - sang the artists, and their paper was adorned in beautiful pictures and chaotic scribbles. 

“[i]This is objectively the best vote[/i]” - said the developers, showing their vote on a monitor presented on a black background. 
“[i]We should pick our vote, else there will be disappointment[/i]”. 

Which vote was chosen, no one can tell, but the voting was concluded, and the Rollercoaster Park will henceforth be called: 

[h1]TRILLIUM PARK[/h1]

[i][b]CONGRATULATIONS Trooper-2H2K!!![/b]
Lest the ground upon which you walk be ever comfortable and steady.[/i]

[b]Stay healthy, stay safe and stay tuned for more Rollercoaster Mechanic info. 
[/b]

notes.title: Brains!
notes.content:
Hello!

Rollercoaster Mechanic development is on the right track, we are currently upgrading our controller and writing some scripts for the UI, while level designing and modeling at the same time!

But today is a special time, as we need your wits, your smarts, your brains!

We want you to help us name the amusement park where the game takes place.
Note, that the park is vast, and divided into many regions with different themes (as shown in previous devlogs).

[b]Got an idea?[/b]
Write it down in the comments, and if the stars align, it will be implemented into the game for all to see! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/eae06e8bb1dab17899952ee27a82390fb8c2c00f.jpg[/img]

[b]As a reward for the best park name: [/b]
[list]
[*] A free game, RollerCoaster Mechanic, some time before the release. 
[*] Your name (nick) will be placed in the game, as a trophy.
[*] The name you created will be presented at the beginning of the game.
[*] You will feel enormous amounts of satisfaction.
[/list]

Hope to read your ideas soon! 

Stay healthy, stay safe, and stay tuned for more Rollercoaster Mechanic info.

notes.title: In the sands of the future
notes.content:

We present to you a couple of future-oriented regions (a work in progress), where you will find thematically consistent rides and challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/2bc27de56d10ff464261f170b6c8556cdb410d34.jpg[/img]

It might look like a science fiction town or a piece of a post-apocalyptic wasteland, but that is just an illusion, scrupulously built for park guests, to shift them into a land of wonders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/14080fdb6c8466a9cca7e03f4138a57b145ffe6e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #5 - May developement summary
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/YTprxjY/rust-remover-discord.gif[/img]

[h2]Hello, Rollercoaster Mechanic community![/h2]

It's time, to sum up, the developement process in May. We made a lot of work in terms of design and modeling. Most of the tools that you will use in Rollercoaster Mechanic are already prepared, but some of them still need improvements before we share them with you. 

Also, other models and functionalities are looking better and better. We will share more details really soon.

Short brief of what we achieved in may:

[list]
[*] Reference architecture model with textures, divided into modular parts.
[*]   Thus, the start of the work of external graphic designers on the basis of the above-mentioned Model over the main level architecture and coordination of work progress and ongoing quality control.
[*]   Tool model - Pew Pew Cleaner
[*]   Fixed bugs related to the UI quest system.
[*]   Fixed character placement after initiating camera zoom in.
[*] Recognition and an outline introduction to the gameplay mechanic.
[*] Numerous in-design improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Stay tuned for upcoming updates![/h2]

notes.title: Devlog #3 - This rollercoaster is almost running!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/wSH7mSZ/Intro.gif[/img]

[h2]Hello, Rollercoaster Mechanic community![/h2]

We are sorry for being so quiet the last couple of weeks. Our dev team closed themself in the cellar of [censored due to legal reasons] park in [censored due to legal reasons] to analyze the construction of biggest rollercoasters in the world ... so you know ... it took some time. Mostly because they had too much fun, and they refused to go home.

Today we would like to show you some parts of the early alpha version of what you will see in the Prologue version of Rollercoaster Mechanic that is coming to Steam later this year. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hd3CPs7/Overview.gif[/img]

In Rollercoaster Mechanic Prologue you will be able to see the first area of the theme park that awaits your help in full version. Fix the main gate, clean the ticket gates are, fix carousels, and make the rollercoaster great again!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxRdm0d/Climb.gif[/img]

Not all problems are on the ground, sometimes you need to climb and fix damages on the height, but this view of happy kids is worth it for sure.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/9bMH42C/Fix.gif[/img]

Not all repairs are easy, sometimes you need to think more and solve puzzles to make machines running.

[b]Thank you for your support, we will try to post more about the game from now. [/b]
Developement is going very nicely and smoothly, and we are so hyped to show you more as soon as it will be ready.

[h3]also, if you wanna know more about Rollercoaster Mechanic and be first to know about all updates join our Forestlight Games Discord channel.[/h3]
